notes: test_cases_conditional_skipped_at_describe = tests wrapped by describes that begin `test.skip(!isTestAuth, ...)` — they RUN when PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_AUTH=true (the Phase 0C default).
test_cases_runtime_skipped are in apps/union-eyes/e2e/ue-workflow.spec.ts (skipped only when GITHUB_ACTOR=dependabot[bot]).
test_cases_hard_skipped are OCRA deep-traversal placeholders (5 in ocra-adaptive-flow.spec.ts §3).

The role_loop_expansion column is important: files iterating over multiple roles produce N × M tests at runtime; total_test_cases counts distinct test() invocations at the source level, not runtime expansions.

class_definitions.A: Current baseline — must pass under Phase 0C deterministic lifecycle.
class_definitions.B: Later-phase — capability not yet built or graduated; must be skipped by mechanism, not by silent pass.
class_definitions.C: Blocked by external dependency (network, third-party API, non-local service); must be marked clearly.
class_definitions.D: Obsolete/duplicate — remove during §14 with rationale in phase-0c-failure-resolution-register.md.
